verdict.rationale: Tavily's core operations take natural language as input. Search accepts plain-language queries, Crawl accepts natural-language instructions, and Research turns a plain-language topic into a report. It also ships an official MCP server and an agent-setup skill, so agents in chat clients can drive and configure it conversationally. However, natural language mainly shapes queries and task inputs. Operating the product more broadly (account, keys, configuration, usage) by natural language is not documented, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: natural-language control of account/configuration/admin operations, independent hands-on evidence of NL-driven operation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
